response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable and rare geospatial/GIS domain expertise with a strong quality assurance mindset and demonstrated understanding of distributed systems from high-throughput microservices work. However, his C++ experience is significantly outdated (last used in 2015), he has no Rust experience, and his career trajectory over the past 5+ years has moved distinctly away from systems programming toward TypeScript/Node.js and business logic. An interview could clarify his genuine interest in returning to systems-level work and capacity to rapidly ramp up on modern C++ for a specialized routing data pipeline role.
strengths: Deep and rare geospatial/GIS domain expertise as founder of GIS Collective and through Green Map navigation data projects—directly relevant to routing pipeline systems

Strong commitment to quality assurance, demonstrated through TDD practices, creation of testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts), and comprehensive testing education—aligning with the role's rigorous QA requirements

Hands-on understanding of distributed systems and high-performance computing from building microservices handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby, showing grasp of fault tolerance and low-latency requirements
concerns: C++ proficiency is severely outdated with no commercial C++ work since 2015 (11+ years ago); modern C++ is the primary requirement, and ability to rapidly ramp up is uncertain
No Rust experience listed on resume, eliminating the alternative technical pathway specified in the job description

Career trajectory shows deliberate movement away from systems programming toward web services, TypeScript, and AI-agent infrastructure, raising questions about motivation and long-term fit for specialized systems engineering

key_factors.factor: Outdated C++ skills and no recent systems programming
Career progression away from low-level systems work
